findings.title: Example patch adds a second TitanMaterialExtension that shadows any content mod's own on Uranium
findings.detail: PatchOperationAddModExtension appends a new <li>; TitanMaterialUtility.Ext uses GetModExtension<TitanMaterialExtension>(), which returns only the first. With the framework loading first, a content mod's own extension on Uranium (commonality, factors, traits, tags) would be silently ignored while this example ships. Either move it out before publishing, as the comment says, or patch an existing extension's traits list instead of adding another extension.

findings.title: Patch and example defs must be removed together or the cross-ref fails at load
findings.detail: Patches/TF_ExampleMaterials.xml refers to TF_Example_Irradiated in Defs/Examples. Deleting Defs/Examples alone leaves an unresolvable cross-reference error at startup. The comment says so; a PatchOperationConditional on the def's existence would make it safe.

findings.title: Irradiated glow bottoms out near 0.075 alpha on a grey statue
findings.detail: color alpha 0.25 times pulseMin 0.3, drawn with additive MoteGlow on uranium's (100,100,100) statue tint, may be nearly invisible at the bottom of the pulse. Intended as faint; worth checking in game.
